Smores - A Smores pastry that offers a perfect mix of crunchiness, creaminess, and rich chocolate. This unique pastry starts with a crispy cookie base filled with delicious caramel. On top of that comes a velvety chocolate ganache. The Italian meringue adds an airy texture, while the topping of creamy chocolate mousse finishes it off with a luxurious touch.
The Smores is the perfect treat for chocolate lovers seeking a rich and refined taste experience.
Whether for a special occasion or as a moment of indulgence for yourself.
Madeleine (6 pieces) - A well-known French cake with fresh orange zest. Available in bags of 6 pieces.

French Almond Croissants - This classic French delicacy is a true treat for the senses.
The soft butter croissant is perfectly baked to a golden brown, crispy crust, while the inside is filled with a delicious almond paste that offers a rich, nutty flavor. The croissant is finished with fine almond flakes and a light dusting of powdered sugar.
This aligns perfectly with your appreciation for French pastries and desserts with unique flavors, particularly those featuring nuts and refined textures

Lemon Meringue - Let yourself be tempted by the fresh and sweet flavors of our lemon meringue pastry, a customer favorite.
This refined pastry combines a crispy base with a creamy lemon cream that offers a refreshing brightness. The airy meringue on top, perfectly caramelized, provides a deliciously sweet contrast to the citrusy filling.
Every bite is a perfect balance between the tartness of lemon and the soft, sweet meringue, making this pastry a delightful treat.
The Lemon Meringue Pastry is an ideal choice for lovers of fresh, fruity delicacies with a touch of luxury. Perfect with coffee, as a refreshing end to a meal, or as a special treat for yourself.

Apple Slice - Enjoy the authentic flavors of the French Tarte Pomme, a classic pastry that reflects the refinement of French patisserie.
This delicious apple slice consists of a crispy, butter puff pastry base filled with a smooth vanilla pastry cream.
The top of the apple slice is beautifully finished with thin slices of apple.

Gloriette Pastry - This delicate pastry consists of airy macaron sponge, perfectly baked for a subtle crunch and a soft texture. Between the two halves lies a rich butter nougatine cream, offering the perfect balance of creaminess and a subtle nutty flavor.
Even this pastry is gluten-free.

The Black Gold - This elegant pastry consists of layers of rich chocolate mousse and chocolate almond sponge, creating an irresistible taste experience thanks to the selected Valrhona chocolate.
A luxurious treat that makes any occasion special. “The Black Gold” is not only a feast for the senses, but also a perfect choice for true chocolate lovers, and this pastry is also gluten-free.
Enjoy the ultimate chocolate pleasure with this masterpiece of patisserie.

Choco Raspberry - This refined pastry combines the rich, creamy taste of Valrhona chocolate with a surprising raspberry filling that provides a refreshing twist. The chocolate almond sponge is light and gluten-free, while the fruity raspberry center delights your taste buds.
Choco Raspberry is the ideal treat for lovers of chocolate and fruit.
A luxurious and flavorful indulgence for any occasion, bringing together the best of both worlds: deep, rich chocolate and the fresh, fruity taste of raspberries.

Caraibe - A perfect interplay of rich flavors and refined textures. This pastry starts with a crunchy hazelnut sponge that adds a subtle, nutty depth. It is followed by a creamy chocolate mousse made from premium Valrhona chocolate, delivering a luxurious, rich taste experience.
At the heart of the pastry is a silky vanilla crémeux, providing the perfect balance to the intense chocolate and nutty sponge. The smooth vanilla filling blends beautifully with the rich chocolate, creating a surprising, creamy center.
This gluten-free masterpiece is a true treat for gourmets and chocolate lovers. It combines the sophisticated flavors of hazelnut, chocolate, and vanilla in one irresistible pastry.
Perfect for any occasion when you want to indulge yourself or others!

Dacquoise Raspberry - This delicate pastry consists of a light almond sponge, which not only tastes delicious but is also completely gluten-free.
A pastry with a silky vanilla mousse that caresses your senses with its creamy texture and rich flavor.
The center is filled with a fresh raspberry filling, providing a fruity counterpoint and creating a perfect balance between sweet and tart.
Enjoy this refined treat, ideal for any occasion and suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy something delicious gluten-free!

Passion - A refined delicacy that offers the perfect balance between exotic flavors and a rich texture.
The pastry starts with a soft almond coconut sponge, which adds a subtle nutty and coconut flavor.
The heart of the pastry is filled with a silky passion fruit mango mousse, perfectly combining the tropical flavors of passion fruit and mango into a light, fruity sensation. This pastry is not only a treat for your taste buds but also a feast for the eyes.
Enjoying gluten-free has never been so delicious!

Petit fours 12 pcs - A luxurious selection of 12 small, delicate pastries that are perfect for any occasion.
Each petit four is a masterpiece of flavor and presentation, with a harmonious balance between refined chocolates, creamy fillings, and subtle fruity notes.
The pastries are beautifully finished with glazes and edible, refined decorations that delight both the palate and the eye.
Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply want to treat yourself, the petit fours offer an elegant and delicious experience in every bite. Perfect for a high tea, a festive table, or as a luxurious treat.

Strawberry Pastry - This delicious strawberry pastry is made with a crispy hard shortcrust base, filled with a light frangipane and creamy vanilla cream made with fresh vanilla. Finished with fresh strawberries for the perfect balance between sweet and refreshing.

Standard birthday cake - Please note... The drip decoration can only be used on the Dacquoise cake. All cakes are packaged in a tube.
Fill in the options and create your own cake!

2 level Birthday Cake - The bottom cake is larger than the top one. This cake is suitable for 14 people.
The bottom cake is always a Dacquoise, because it is the sturdiest.
You can choose the flavor of the top cake yourself. Fill in your preferences and create your own cake! Always mention you allergies and dietary restrictions in the notes.

Big Birthday Cake - Create your own cake from scratch! 🎉
Choose the number of people, add a theme or decorations, and customize the cake entirely to your wishes. Please write your allergies and food preferences in the notes.
📸 The cake in the photo is a version for 30 people with the flavor Dacquoise (vanilla-raspberry).

Paris Brest Cake - A truly traditional French pastry.
This ring-shaped cake is made from choux pastry filled with a hazelnut cream and crunchy hazelnuts.
This cake was originally created by a French pastry chef for a cycling tournament.
The cake is designed to resemble a bicycle tire.

Gloriette - A "Miserable" cake, named after the Gloriette of Meerssen.
A delicious regional specialty.
Made from a soft almond sponge cake with a butter-nougatine cream.
Serves 6–8 people.

Smores Truffels - Deze handgemaakte truffels zijn gevuld met zachte gianduja en worden omhuld door een rijk laagje cacaopoeder voor een perfecte balans van zoetheid en diepte.
Wat deze truffels extra bijzonder maakt, is de toevoeging van hazelnoten uit Piemonte, die een subtiele nootachtige crunch geven die heerlijk contrasteert met de romige vulling.
De hazelnoten worden met zorg geselecteerd uit de regio Piemonte, bekend om zijn hoogwaardige hazelnoten die een delicate smaak en textuur bieden.
De combinatie van zachte gianduja, rijke cacao en de knapperige hazelnoten maakt van deze truffels een ware specialiteit, ideaal om te delen of om jezelf mee te verwennen bij een bijzonder moment.

Raisin Swirl - Our traditional French Raisin Swirl mixes a timeless flavor with a hint of sweetness. Flaky, buttery layers surround a luscious raisin center, making any bite memorable. A great treat for any moment of day.
Chocolate & Passion Fruit - Chocolate cookie filled with passion fruit coulis and topped with passion fruit jam.

Chausson aux pommes - Our classic French Chausson aux pommes is an expression of coated elegance. With a crispy buttery crust and a creamy, spiced apple inside, every bite is pure delight. Ideal for any time of day.
Pavlova - A pavlova cake features a crisp meringue base topped with a luscious combination of mascarpone and whipped cream, finished with fresh fruit
Millefeuille cake - Millefeuille is a classic French pastry consisting of layers of puff pastry alternating with layers of pastry cream, topped with powdered sugar for a sweet and flaky treat.

Medovik - Russian honeycake - Medovik, also known as "Russian Honey Cake," is a classic and beloved Russian dessert. This cake is characterized by its unique layers of thin, honey-infused sponge cake separated by a luscious sweetened sour cream.
Macarons Cake - Macarons Cake – made with light macaron shells, creamy vanilla filling, fluffy raspberry mousse, and sweet raspberry jam.
Macarons Cake - Additional view 1
Chocolate Raspberry cake - Indulge in this delightful dark chocolate cake, filled with raspberry mousse, chocolate mousse and fresh raspberry coulis. A true taste sensation of bittersweet refinement.

Eclair Karamel St. Honore - Indulge yourself in the ultimate treat: our delightful St. Honore éclair! Filled with blissful caramel cream and generously covered with velvety vanilla Chantilly, this heavenly delicacy is a true delight for the senses! Let yourself be enchanted by the delicious flavors and elegant French flair of our St. Honore éclair.
Eclair Chocolat Noir - Savor our éclair filled with airy dark chocolate ganache, topped with glossy chocolate glaze and crunchy chocolate crisps. A delightful indulgence in every bite!
Eclair Earl Grey Srawberry - A delicious éclair with a velvety Earl Grey cream filling, refined with a hint of homemade strawberry jam, and topped with a light Earl Grey chantilly.
Eclair Exotic - A delectable eclair bursting with a luscious mango-passionfruit cream filling, adorned with a light coconut mousse and a tantalizing mango-passionfruit jelly on top.

Eclair Paris Brest - Discover French elegance in every bite with our Eclair Paris-Brest. This pastry masterpiece combines the classic flavors of a Parisian eclair with the iconic round shape of a Paris-Brest. Enjoy the soft, airy choux pastry filled with a creamy hazelnut praline cream. Let yourself be seduced by the perfect balance of sweet and nutty, and experience the indulgence of French pastry with our Eclair Paris-Brest.

Eclair Pecan Caramel - An Eclair filled with a decadent dark chocolate cream, enrobed in a luscious caramel coating adorned with crunchy roasted pecan nuts, and elegantly dusted with shimmering gold for a touch of luxury and indulgence.
Eclair Pistache Framboos - A delightful éclair with a savory pistachio cream filling, subtly enriched with a touch of raspberry jelly and covered with a lush layer of raspberry mousse.
Eclair Vanilla - A delightful twist on the classic: luscious vanilla cream nestled within a crisp choux pastry, enrobed in a decadent chocolate glaze and adorned with intricate chocolate decorations.

Eclair Yuzu Meringue - An elegant eclair boasting a zesty yuzu cremeux filling nestled within tender pastry, elegantly enveloped by a cloud-like Swiss meringue. Yuzu, a citrus fruit with a unique blend of tartness and floral notes, infuses the dessert with refreshing brightness, complementing the sweetness of the meringue perfectly.

Eclair Blauwebes Lavendel - An éclair filled with a delightful combination of airy chantilly and lavender cream, enriched with a smooth blueberry coulis. Topped with a glaze of blueberry ganache and adorned with juicy blueberries, resulting in a delectable treat with a perfect balance of sweetness and refreshment.

Sable Nantaise - Our Sablé Nantaise biscuits are traditional French butter cookies with a tender, crumbly texture and a rich, buttery flavor. A timeless classic, perfect for pairing with tea or coffee.

Madeleines - Our madeleines are classic French butter cakes with a light, fluffy texture and a delicate golden crust. Perfectly baked with a hint of vanilla and lemon, they’re an elegant treat for any occasion.

Bonbons L'Odyssee Exquise - The iconic flavors of the Manufacture brought together in a single box. This selection showcases the CLUIZEL taste: intense chocolate with low sugar content, presented in a beautifully designed box, perfect for gifting and sharing. Featuring a 99% cocoa ganache, chocolates from the Mangaro Plantation in Madagascar, raspberry-filled palets, the Perle d’Or with its nougatine praline of almonds and hazelnuts, chocolate-coated bonbons, and soft salted butter caramel from Guérande... The L’Odyssée Exquise boxes offer authentic and delicious combinations, a gourmet testament to the craftsmanship of CLUIZEL as a Cacaofèvier®, confectioner, and chocolatier.

Very Berry Cake - Whether you're seeking a treat for yourself or a delightful dessert to share during special occasions, our cake of madeleine sponge, strawberry coulis, vanilla cream, and fresh seasonal fruits promises to provide an experience that will enchant all your senses. Enjoy a moment of pure delight with every delectable bite!

Tropical cake - Whether you're searching for a delicious dessert for a special occasion or simply craving a bit of tropical indulgence, our Tropical Cake is the perfect choice. Let yourself be transported to a paradise of flavor with every delightful bite!

Happy Box - Among them, you find classic flavors like chocolate, vanilla, offering comforting familiarity. Then, there are more adventurous options such as raspberry pistachio, passionfruit, and earl grey tea with strawberry, enticing your taste buds with exotic twists. Finally, whimsical creations like caramel, yuzu and hazelnut praline add a playful yet sophisticated touch to the assortment, promising a delightful journey of flavors with every bite.
Sable Diamant - Our Sablé Diamant biscuits are buttery, melt-in-your-mouth cookies with a delicate crunch from their sugar-coated edges. Perfectly crafted for a luxurious and irresistible treat.

Amaretti - Amaretti with candied oranges are delicate almond-based cookies infused with the bright, citrusy flavor of candied oranges. These sweet treats offer a harmonious blend of nuttiness from the almonds and a zesty kick from the candied oranges, creating a delightful balance of flavors in every bite.
